_comment: Operator Key reasoning configuration.
Copy this file to the path the app prints in its own status line and edit it there.
On Linux that is normally ~/.config/operator-key/reasoning.json.
Operator Key ships NO model, NO API key and NO account. Reasoning is OFF until you
point this file at a model you run yourself. Nothing here is required to search,
copy or insert commands: those work offline, forever, with reasoning disabled.
The app only ever talks to 127.0.0.1 or ::1. A non-loopback endpoint is refused
before a connection is attempted, so this file cannot be used to exfiltrate your
catalog to a remote service.
PROVIDERS
disabled            Default. No model is contacted.
ollama              A local Ollama daemon (https://ollama.com). Start with:
ollama serve && ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:7b
openai-compatible   Any local server exposing /v1/chat/completions, such as
llama.cpp's llama-server, LM Studio, or vLLM.
codex               The Codex CLI, using ITS OWN sign-in. Operator Key never
reads, stores or transmits your Codex credentials.
MODEL SIZE
This task is ranking and explaining commands the app already selected, not
writing code. A 7B local model is sufficient. The app never runs model-authored
text: it can only reorder and explain catalog entries it supplied itself.
API KEYS
api_key_env names an ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE, never a key. The value is read at
request time and never written to disk or logged. Leave it null for local
servers, which normally need no authentication.
